post.text:
David Attenborough spent over 70 years teaching humanity about earth; he just turned 100. 
Thank you David, you're a light amongst the darkness. https://t.co/hJpIJjlZ4C
post.author_description:
We are Anonymous, we are legion, we do not forgive, we do not forget. Expect us. 

Here to counter propaganda and un-fuck your mind!

description.description: A close-up photograph of Sir David Attenborough in a sunny meadow filled with yellow buttercups. He is smiling warmly while holding a tiny harvest mouse on his fingers, carefully observing the small creature as it explores a plant stem. He is wearing a light blue button-down shirt.

A close-up portrait of Sir David Attenborough. He has white hair and is smiling gently at the camera. He is wearing a blue jacket over a light blue sweater and a white collared shirt. The background is a soft-focus outdoor setting with greens and tans.

A portrait of Sir David Attenborough, an elderly man with white hair, wearing a light blue button-down shirt and a greyish-blue blazer. He is looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. The background is slightly out of focus, showing a decorative wall or screen with geometric patterns and red accents.
